triples.subject: Mitya
triples.quote: The prisoner, running away in the garden in the dark, climbed over the fence, was seized by the servant, and knocked him down with a brass pestle.

triples.subject: Mitya
triples.quote: that brass pestle which he had taken from the two women, and which they could always recognize afterwards as theirs, and prove that he had taken it from them.

triples.subject: Mitya
triples.quote: ‘If he had carried that envelope away with him, no one in the world would have known of that envelope and of the notes in it, and that the money had been stolen by the prisoner.’

triples.subject: Fetyukovitch
triples.quote: although he practiced in Petersburg, he had more than once visited provincial towns to defend prisoners, of whose innocence he had a conviction or at least a preconceived idea.
